thread:
maya: Heads up — Acme Retail account (acct_ACME_998) was flagged by dunning this morning for overdue invoice INV-2026-334. Customer says their PO was uploaded but system rejected it. They also reported card decline yesterday and API calls now return 403, so their customers are hitting errors.

billing-bot: Automated dunning notice sent to acct_ACME_998 at 2026-03-17T08:10:23Z — balance $12,450.00 overdue 14 days. Access level: suspended (non-critical APIs rate-limited).

jordan: Thanks @maya — can you paste the customer's PO number + screenshot of the upload error? If we have audit logs we can check why PO wasn't accepted.

maya: PO: PO-778122. Customer pasted this in the support portal; screenshot says "PO validation failed: tax_vat_mismatch". They attached VAT certificate but maybe wrong country code. They also included a curl snippet showing 403: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-ACME" 
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' 
# response: 403 Forbidden {"error":"account_suspended","message":"billing overdue"}
```

leo: I pulled the invoice: INV-2026-334 shows VAT applied at 20% but their EU VAT exemption claim is on file for a different entity name (Acme Retail EU vs Acme Retail). The PO references Acme Retail EU but the account is registered under Acme Retail (global). We need a matching VAT reg number and matching billing entity on the PO.

support-ops: Escalating to finance-escalations for PO validation override request. Customer requests immediate reinstatement for read-only API while they sort PO. They are offering to pay outstanding balance if we can accept provisional access.

finance-escalations: We can offer temporary limited access while we verify documents, but per policy we need either: (1) a valid PO that matches the invoiced legal entity and VAT reg number, or (2) receipt of cleared payment for the overdue balance. If they can provide a scanned VAT certificate showing matching legal name and VAT ID, we can clear the dunning hold.

maya: Customer is pushing — says their procurement team retried the upload and got the same tax_vat_mismatch error. They asked if we can re-run PO validation manually.

jordan: I'll pull the PO upload logs. @billing-bot can you provide the validation error details for PO-778122?

billing-bot: PO upload record: PO-778122, uploaded 2026-03-16T21:44Z by user maya@acme.com. Validation failure: field_mapping.vat_id mismatch (expected format EU:GB999999973; received: "GB-999999973"). Also entity_name_normalized mismatch: "ACME RETAIL" vs "ACME RETAIL EU".

leo: Looks like formatting is the issue — they included a hyphen in the VAT id. Our parser expects no punctuation. We can accept if finance team confirms entity match. If they can re-upload cleaned VAT ID (remove hyphen) we'll do a manual accept.

maya: I've relayed that. Customer said they can re-upload within 30 minutes but urgently need access because their checkout is failing and they're getting conversion hits. Any chance of temporary read-only access whitelist for their API key?

finance-escalations: We can provision a read-only tier for 24 hours if they provide a signed PO + proof of payment intent (email from procurement confirming payment schedule) AND they grant a payment method to charge if payment fails. This is an exception; need explicit sign-off from on-call finance lead.

jordan: Noted. @leo — can you OK the exception if they upload corrected VAT doc? If so, I'll send a conditional reinstatement note and set a 24h monitor.

leo: OK pending corrected VAT doc and procurement email. I'll sign off once I see the cleaned VAT id format and matching entity.

support-ops: Action items: 1) maya to ask customer to re-upload VAT without punctuation and ensure legal entity matches invoice. 2) maya to collect procurement email confirming payment intent. 3) jordan to prepare temporary whitelist policy (read-only) and a revoke script. 4) leo to review and sign.

maya: Doing that now. I'll paste back confirmation and the new upload link when I have it. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Note attached to account: provisional access requested at 2026-03-17T08:19:11Z. Audit trail will require manual revocation if conditions not met.

jordan: If they can't get the VAT doc in 24h, we'll need cleared payment. Also flag for collections: do not proceed to external collections while we have an active escalation thread and procurement contact on record.

finance-escalations: Agreed — hold collections for 72 hours while we attempt reconciliation. If no response, we'll proceed per collections policy.

maya: Customer replied — procurement confirmed they'll re-upload with VAT id without punctuation and attached a procurement approval email. They've re-uploaded a document; screenshot shows success. I'll attach the upload (forwarded).

billing-bot: New PO document received: PO-778122, updated 2026-03-17T08:31:02Z. PO validation: PASSED (vat_id normalized to GB999999973, entity match confirmed).

leo: Verified invoice mapping now matches. I'm clearing the dunning hold and authorizing temporary full API access for 2 hours to let them validate end-to-end. After 2 hours, revert to normal rules unless payment clears.

maya: Confirmed — I informed Acme. They tested the curl and now get 200. Thanks everyone.

jordan: Closing the escalation once payments team confirms clearance or after 72h if no payment. Please add any final notes.

maya: Added notes to ticket #12345 with docs and steps. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
